title: FlowMLLab: An Open-Source Framework for Reproducible CFD-to-Scientific-Machine-Learning Experiments
description: FlowMLLab v1.9.0 extends Week 16 supersonic shape optimization with NASA SEEB-ALR original geometry and pressure records, an executable reference CFD comparison, a recovered frozen-prediction neural audit, detailed teaching guides and an executed notebook. It fixes optimization from a clean checkout. The neural audit concerns a refit of our two-parameter architecture; NASA validates the CFD benchmark separately. Full Beihang aircraft reproduction, original author neural weights, atmospheric propagation and ground PLdB are not claimed.
